title: SLO-first adaptive routing with hosted grace-backoff and variant demotion
creator: Ayesha Patel
description: Design and implement an SLO-prioritized routing layer that prefers customer Dedicated pools but gracefully falls back to Hosted with an adaptive grace-backoff window and transparent model-variant demotion. The goal is to minimize customer-visible latency and error-rate regressions during capacity shortfalls while preserving unit-cost and tenant isolation guarantees.
proposed_solution: 1) Introduce an SLO score per request (computed from tenant SLO target, route SLA, and recent error/latency metrics). 2) Prefer Dedicated routes when score >= threshold; otherwise consider hosted spillover with a graded grace-backoff period that permits short bursts to Hosted before hard failover. 3) Attach a confidence tag to routed requests; when demoting model variants (quantized or smaller family), apply output-quality gating and optional QA sampling. 4) Track per-tenant budget for hosted fallback to avoid runaway costs and allow tenant-configurable risk profiles (strict, balanced, permissive). 5) Emit detailed telemetry for every decision to Console for post-hoc analysis and automated rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Routing layer computes SLO score and logs decision with reason for >95% of requests in canary region
Dedicated-first routing succeeds for tenants with available capacity and respects affinity windows
Hosted grace-backoff allows controlled spillover for 30s bursts by default, configurable per-tenant
Model-variant demotion only applies when quality gating passes; regression rate <1% in canary
Per-tenant hosted budget prevents >2x expected hosted spend without explicit opt-in
Observability: per-request tags, decision traces and a Console dashboard with realtime counts and cost impact
implementation_notes: Add SLO-score calculator in routing-service; keep computation O(1) and cache policy config in memory
Extend control-plane API to accept tenant risk profile and hosted budget override
Implement grace-backoff state machine with hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping under oscillation
Integrate variant-demotion hooks with model-catalog to select compatible fallback models and attach QA sampling flags
Emit structured logs (json) and perf counters to existing tracing + metrics pipeline; add new Console panels
Plan canary in eu-west-1 with 5 pilot tenants before global rollout
testing_plan: Unit tests for SLO scoring and state transitions, integration tests exercising Dedicated->Hosted->DemotedVariant paths, chaos test that simulates Dedicated pool exhaustion, cost simulation validating hosted budget controls, and a 72-hour canary with shadow traffic to measure quality regressions.
